target.statement: ToM with DeepSeek-V3 achieves 38.60 F1 on InfiniteBench Question-Answering (Inf.QA)

compute.basis: Requires serving a 671B-parameter DeepSeek-V3 model (needs ~160GB VRAM in FP8, impossible on 16GB RAM CPU) plus a 3B HSP model, and running hundreds of LLM calls over 100 ultra-long documents; even with API access, the full protocol would take many hours.

blockers: Requires DeepSeek-V3 (671B parameters), which cannot run on a normal laptop (8 CPU cores, 16 GB RAM, no GPU)
Requires a 3B-scale Hierarchical Semantic Parser LLM for DocTree construction
Requires serving large models with vLLM, needing GPU memory far beyond a laptop
Even with API access, the full protocol involves hundreds of LLM calls over 100 ultra-long documents, exceeding a few hours
title: ToM: Leveraging Tree-oriented MapReduce for Long-Context Reasoning in Large Language Models
